mcp.stdioHint: Commands run on the backend server. Install dependencies first; use docker for an isolated container. The connection manager starts the process and closes it when disabled.
mcp.importHint: Supports mcpServers and VS Code mcp.servers / servers. Preview before importing; existing names are never overwritten. Replace variable placeholders with values first.
mcp.openAuthorization: Open authorization (return and refresh when done)
mcp.revoked: Remote token revoked and local credentials cleared.
mcp.disconnectedLocal: Local credentials cleared. Remote revocation was not confirmed; use the provider account settings to revoke access if needed.
mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Skills guide how tasks are done; MCP provides external tools. Connections run on the server for Q&A and Bot conversations.
mcp.offline: Connect to the backend to configure MCP.
mcp.deleteConfirm: Delete the connection for “{{name}}”? Conversation history will be kept.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.transportHint: Select the service's Streamable HTTP or legacy SSE endpoint. The URL must be reachable from the backend.
mcp.oauthHint: Save, then start OAuth authorization. The provider must support dynamic client registration.
mcp.missingDependencies: {{skill}}: MCP dependencies unavailable in this conversation: {{servers}}
mcp.secretHint: Credentials are encrypted on the server. Leave blank to keep, enter a replacement, or clear explicitly below.
mcp.scopeHint: Only selected servers are available in this conversation. Inherit global includes servers enabled in the future.
mcp.scopeNone: All MCP servers disabled for this conversation

errors.mcp_import_fields: Configuration contains unsupported fields. Review before importing.
errors.mcp_import_variables: Replace environment or input placeholders first.
errors.mcp_import_duplicate: A server with that name already exists. Nothing imported; rename it first.
errors.mcp_invalid_command: Check the executable, JSON arguments array and absolute server working directory.
errors.mcp_oauth_required: Complete OAuth authorization in settings first.
errors.mcp_oauth_state: Authorization expired or already used. Start again.
errors.mcp_oauth_failed: OAuth authorization failed. Check the provider's authorization support.
errors.mcp_oauth_origin: Set MCP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN to the publicly reachable backend origin.
errors.generic: Operation failed. Check the connection and try again.
errors.mcp_auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check the token, headers or authorize with OAuth again.
errors.mcp_timeout: Connection or tool call timed out. Check the server or adjust the timeout.
errors.mcp_connection_failed: Cannot connect. Check the transport, URL or executable, dependencies and network.
errors.mcp_invalid_url: Use an HTTP(S) URL without user info, query parameters or a fragment. Configure authentication separately.
errors.mcp_invalid_config: Check the name, transport, URL and timeout (1–120 seconds).
errors.mcp_invalid_credentials: Invalid credentials. Headers and environment must be JSON objects of strings; protocol headers cannot be overridden.
errors.mcp_server_limit: At most 30 servers can be configured.
errors.mcp_tools_unsupported: This server does not support MCP tools.
errors.mcp_catalog_limit: Tool catalog too large. Reduce the tools exposed by the server.
errors.mcp_config_changed: Configuration changed. Test the connection again.

agent.title: Agent default instructions
agent.subtitle: Set lasting response preferences and learning habits in Markdown. This is the same /system/AGENTS.md shown in the library: edits stay in sync, and the Agent can read it directly.
agent.label: Global instructions (Markdown)
agent.hint: Saved automatically and applied to your next message, including in existing conversations. Leave empty for the app defaults.
agent.placeholder:
# Response preferences
- Answer in English, starting with the conclusion.
- Introduce abstract concepts with a concrete example.

# Learning habits
- Explain the reason for each step in a derivation.
- State uncertainty instead of guessing.
agent.saved: Saved automatically · Applies to your next message
agent.resetConfirm: This clears your global instructions and restores the app defaults. Conversations and skills will not be deleted.
agent.scope: Applies to the library assistant, course Q&A, and reading-material Q&A. Supplements rather than replaces built-in prompts; does not change transcription, background content generation, or skill text. Tool boundaries, factual grounding, and citation formats are retained. Instructions sync with settings when cloud sync is enabled; do not include passwords or API keys.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Follow your system theme or choose a light or dark theme and an accent color
appearance.fontScaleHint: Scales interface text and controls together. Standard uses the browser default (16px). Choose another size if it feels too small or too large.
appearance.accentColorHint: Changes the accent for buttons, selections, and focus indicators
appearance.dynamicColorHint: Uses the course cover color to personalize the player. Falls back to the default palette when no cover color is available.

reading.title: Reading materials
reading.subtitle: Applies only to HTML. PDF, Word, and Markdown materials are self-contained and do not need network access.
reading.remoteAssetsHint: Loads remote images, stylesheets, and fonts referenced by HTML materials. Turn off for offline reading using embedded resources only; skipped resources are noted in the reader. Scripts never run in either mode.
